flags.why: The entry omits the common colloquial meaning of intravenous fluid, as in truyền nước biển ([usage](https://tudien.dolenglish.vn/truyen-nuoc-bien-tieng-anh-la-gi)).
The exclusion of Antarctica is false: Vietnamese uses châu Nam Cực ([textbook](https://lib.hpu.edu.vn/bitstream/handle/123456789/34185/Dia-li-7.pdf?isAllowed=y&sequence=1)).
The hamlet sense is used mainly in Southern Vietnam and needs a regional tag ([reference](https://scholar.dlu.edu.vn/thuvienso/bitstream/DLU123456789/225170/1/CVv320S012016041.pdf)).
Bỗng is neutral and occurs in ordinary speech, so literary misleadingly restricts its use ([reference](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/dot-nhien-ehQWRTr2LYE8K.html)).
